purpose: Measure corrected numeric-string action menus on a fresh four-case family with model, random/order and deterministic-procedure controls. No training and no default promotion.

acceptance.package_accept_if: all three neural arms and the deterministic procedure run to terminal state, menus include exact numeric constants, all model scores/indices and receipts are retained, and guard completes
acceptance.quality_rule: report model, random/order and procedure outcomes separately; no default promotion and no free-form capability claim
acceptance.defer_if: guard stop, missing candidate evidence, malformed protocol, or a required control does not run

claims: Fresh corrected-interface measurement only; narrow host-enumerated action menus, not free-form policy, learned capability or model promotion.
